task: Cover the survey builder (`/`), seeded with two questions (`How did you hear about us?` with three options, `Which features do you use?` with two). Add option adds an option to that question only, and Remove option removes exactly that option; the counter line (`2 questions · 5 options`) follows both. Move question up and Move question down reorder the questions. Preview opens a preview region that renders the questions in their current order, each with its options as radio buttons (single choice) or checkboxes (multiple choice); the button then reads Hide preview. Options and order are stored on the server and survive a reload.
